_comment: RSS feed list for the news pipeline (EN edition). Copy a block and set your name/url/emoji/tags. name — the source caption on the card (the 'Source: …' line); url — the RSS feed address (Russian agencies publish in Russian — the AI translates; world feeds publish in English — the AI simply condenses them); emoji — the post icon if the AI picked no topical one; tags — labels in the table of contents (the first one is the primary tag). The pipeline walks the sources in a circle (rotation) so that busy Russian agencies do not crowd out world feeds. A failing source is simply skipped — the pipeline never falls over.
